name: anything-llm
description: The best solution for turning private documents into a chat bot using off-the-shelf tools and commercially viable AI technologies.
author: Timothy Carambat (Mintplex Labs)

scripts.lint: cd server && yarn lint && cd ../frontend && yarn lint && cd ../collector && yarn lint
scripts.lint:ci: cd server && yarn lint:check && cd ../frontend && yarn lint:check && cd ../collector && yarn lint:check
scripts.check:modular-p0: yarn check:modules && yarn build:web && yarn build:api && yarn build:collector
scripts.check:modular-p3: yarn check:modules && yarn prisma:generate && yarn build:reader-module && yarn build:reader-worker && yarn build:background-worker && cd server && npx eslint endpoints/workspaceReaderDocuments.js utils/dataAccess/dataAccessCenter.js utils/devControl/readerCommands.js --no-warn-ignored && yarn data-access:enforce
scripts.check:modular-p4: yarn check:modular-p3 && yarn build:realtime-gateway && yarn build:crypto-module
scripts.build:reader-module: cd server && node -c modules/reader/index.js && node -c modules/reader/runtime.js && node -c modules/reader/httpAdapter.js && node -c modules/reader/implementation.js && npx eslint modules/reader utils/readerDocumentRuntime providers/readerDocumentStorageProvider.js utils/devControl/readerCommands.js __tests__/utils/readerModuleBoundary.test.js --no-warn-ignored && cd ../frontend && npx eslint src/modules/reader --no-warn-ignored
scripts.build:crypto-module: cd server && node -c modules/crypto/index.js && node -c modules/crypto/runtime.js && node -c modules/crypto/httpAdapter.js && node -c modules/crypto/httpCenterHandlers.js && node -c modules/crypto/httpHubHandlers.js && node -c modules/crypto/httpGateHandlers.js && npx eslint modules/crypto endpoints/cryptoCenter.js endpoints/cryptoHub.js endpoints/cryptoGateProbe.js repositories/cryptoRepository.js utils/BackgroundWorkers/index.js __tests__/utils/cryptoModuleBoundary.test.js --no-warn-ignored && cd ../frontend && npx eslint src/modules/crypto src/pages/Admin/CryptoCenter src/hooks/cryptoHub src/lib/communication/crypto src/utils/serverState/cryptoServerStateStore.js --no-warn-ignored
scripts.build:reader-worker: cd server && node -c reader-worker.js && npx eslint reader-worker.js utils/runtimeRole utils/readerWorker utils/readerDocumentRuntime models/readerWorkerJob.js repositories/readerWorkerJobRepository.js __tests__/utils/readerWorker*.test.js --no-warn-ignored
scripts.build:background-worker: cd server && node -c background-worker.js && npx eslint background-worker.js utils/runtimeRole utils/backgroundWorker __tests__/utils/backgroundWorker*.test.js __tests__/utils/runtimeRole.test.js --no-warn-ignored
scripts.build:realtime-gateway: cd server && node -c realtime-gateway.js && npx eslint realtime-gateway.js endpoints/syncCenter.js utils/broadcast utils/realtimeGateway __tests__/utils/broadcastTransportRegistry.test.js __tests__/utils/realtimeGatewayRuntime.test.js --no-warn-ignored
scripts.setup: cd server && yarn && cd ../collector && yarn && cd ../frontend && yarn && cd .. && yarn setup:envs && yarn prisma:setup && echo "Please run yarn dev:server, yarn dev:collector, and yarn dev:frontend in separate terminal tabs."
scripts.setup:envs:
cp -n ./frontend/.env.example ./frontend/.env; cp -n ./server/.env.example ./server/.env.development; cp -n ./collector/.env.example ./collector/.env; cp -n ./docker/.env.example ./docker/.env; echo "All ENV files copied!
"
scripts.dev:reader-worker: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ATHENA_RUNTIME_ROLE=reader-worker node reader-worker.js
scripts.dev:background-worker: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ATHENA_RUNTIME_ROLE=background-worker ATHENA_BACKGROUND_INLINE=false node background-worker.js
scripts.dev:realtime-gateway: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ATHENA_RUNTIME_ROLE=realtime-gateway node realtime-gateway.js
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && node scripts/prisma-runtime.js migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:seed: cd server && node scripts/prisma-runtime.js db seed
scripts.prisma:setup: yarn prisma:generate && yarn prisma:migrate && yarn prisma:seed
scripts.prisma:reset: cd server && node scripts/prisma-runtime.js migrate reset --force
scripts.desktop:prepare: cd frontend && yarn build && cd ../desktop && npm run prepare:desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:win: cd frontend && yarn build && cd ../desktop && npm run dist:win
scripts.translations:normalize: cd frontend/src/locales && node normalizeEn.mjs && cd ../../.. && cd frontend && yarn lint && cd .. && yarn translations:verify
scripts.translations:prune: cd frontend/src/locales && node findUnusedTranslations.mjs --delete && cd ../../../ && yarn translations:normalize
